features: Adds checkbox-selected memo editing: select exactly one record and press 編輯勾選 to load it into the existing memo form.
During edit mode SAVE becomes UPDATE; submitting uses PUT /api/memos and overwrites the selected R2 memo while preserving its original id and created_at.
The edit action can be cancelled without changing R2, and the record being edited is highlighted with the existing cyberpunk visual language.
Existing cross-device R2 save/load/delete behavior and all unspecified Terminal UI/engine behavior remain unchanged.
